title: 2025-05-14 Stage 2 Scene-Extraction Rulings
lede: Eighteen judgment calls need a ruling. Seventeen unambiguous corrections are already applied; nine Trivial or previously resolved advisories were logged but not queued.
footer: Applied without asking: 17 unambiguous corrections across seven scene files (01, 02, 03, 04, 06, 07, and 08). Left unchanged and unqueued: nine Trivial or previously resolved advisories.

items.t: [Moderate] Gary’s Brewbarry discussion should not be attributed to Valphine.
items.y: In scene_extractions/01_character_introductions_and_backstories.md, relabel out-of-character Brewbarry concept-building as Gary Young and clear first-person character lines as Brewbarry. Valphine will no longer appear to narrate Brewbarry’s exile, loneliness, tea, and musical preferences.
items.n: Leave the Valphine labels beginning at scene_extractions/01_character_introductions_and_backstories.md:313 unchanged and defer the attribution conflict.
items.ev: The VTT warns that Gary voiced both PCs and that a player label must not be converted automatically at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:15. The affected blocks begin at scene_extractions/01_character_introductions_and_backstories.md:313.

items.t: [Moderate] Wade should be identified as jokingly supplying Vukradin’s proposed song payment.
items.y: Change the label at scene_extractions/01_character_introductions_and_backstories.md:293 to Wade Brown with a note that he is supplying Vukradin’s offer; the audio speaker and the joke’s narrative target will both remain explicit.
items.n: Keep the quotation labeled Soma, leaving the audio speaker and the later Vukradin framing in tension.
items.ev: The VTT assigns the line to Wade at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:1541; Vukradin immediately answers, ‘Wait, I have to pay her?’

items.t: [Moderate] The ‘my drow cleric’ exchange should retain player-level uncertainty.
items.y: At scene_extractions/01_character_introductions_and_backstories.md:385, replace the inferred PC labels with Gary Young and Kostadis Roussos [?], adding notes that the intended characters are uncertain. No PC will be credited without evidence.
items.n: Keep the first line attributed to Valphine and the reply to Kostadis, preserving the current third-person contradiction.
items.ev: The VTT records Gary for the first line at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:1781 and uncertain Kostadis for the reply at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:1789.

items.t: [Moderate] Gary’s opening flyer questions should not be attributed specifically to Valphine.
items.y: Relabel the three opening flyer-question blocks beginning at scene_extractions/02_a_new_beginning_setting_out_from_neverwinter.md:22 as Gary Young. This preserves the known player while avoiding an unsupported choice between Gary’s two PCs.
items.n: Leave all three questions attributed to Valphine and accept the unsupported character inference.
items.ev: The cleaned VTT’s attribution rule is explicit at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:15: Gary voiced Valphine and Brewbarry, so the PC must not be inferred from his speaker label.

items.t: [Moderate] ‘Love music with notes’ should not be attributed to Valphine.
items.y: Change the label at scene_extractions/02_a_new_beginning_setting_out_from_neverwinter.md:391 to ‘Gary Young — possibly as Brewbarry.’ This will preserve both the known speaker and the contextual uncertainty.
items.n: Keep the line labeled Valphine, making her appear to supply Brewbarry’s musical characterization.
items.ev: The VTT identifies Gary at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:3153; the surrounding exchange is about Brewbarry communicating through music.

items.t: [Moderate] The closing beat should acknowledge that the flyer and guard scenes occur before departure.
items.y: Rename scene_extractions/02_a_new_beginning_setting_out_from_neverwinter.md:421 from ‘On the Road South’ to ‘At Neverwinter’s Walls and On the Road South.’ The single beat will accurately cover both the city-wall discussion and subsequent travel.
items.n: Keep ‘On the Road South,’ allowing the heading to imply that the pre-departure discussion happened after the party left.
items.ev: The GM corrects the timeline at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:3101: the party has not left Neverwinter yet.

items.t: [Moderate] The party—not Toblen—should be credited with saying it cannot afford rooms.
items.y: Revise scene_extractions/04_arrival_at_the_stonehill_inn.md:18 and :512 to say that after the party says it cannot afford rooms, Toblen directs it to the quest board.
items.n: Keep the current wording that Toblen notes or admits the party cannot afford lodging.
items.ev: Toblen merely offers a room at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:4609; Gary then says ‘I can’t afford to live here’ at :4617.

items.t: [Moderate] The actual Dwarven Excavation task should be distinguished from Soma’s ‘letter’ joke.
items.y: At scene_extractions/05_the_phandalin_quest_board.md:16 and :267, state that the formal task is to deliver a warning and identify ‘literally just delivering a letter’ as Soma’s joke; the verbatim quote at :219 will remain untouched.
items.n: Keep the narrative treating a physical letter as the quest object, even though none is established.
items.ev: The quest text says ‘Take the warning to them’ at docs/chapters/chapter_02_arrival_in_phandalin.md:157; Soma’s joke appears in the VTT at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:5373.

items.t: [Moderate] Harbin’s Gnomengarde role should not be described as taking a cut.
items.y: Replace ‘Townmaster’s cut’ at scene_extractions/05_the_phandalin_quest_board.md:15 and :266 with his participation in the acquisition scheme—offering 50 gp for a useful item the party does not keep.
items.n: Keep wording that implies Harbin receives a share of proceeds from the Gnomengarde transaction.
items.ev: The notice makes Harbin the buyer at docs/chapters/chapter_02_arrival_in_phandalin.md:167; Vukradin objects to his participation at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:4957.

items.t: [Moderate] ‘Deal Struck’ should not imply that the party promised to clear the temple.
items.y: Rename scene_extractions/07_meeting_the_prospectors.md:598 to ‘Message Delivered, Investigation Accepted’ and revise :603 to say the party agrees to enter and assess the temple before deciding whether to clear it.
items.n: Keep ‘Deal Struck’ and ‘decides to go in,’ preserving the stronger commitment framing.
items.ev: Vukradin says ‘we’ll consider for you’ at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:7005; Soma proposes only a look around at :7089.

items.t: [Moderate] The second secret door’s discovery mechanism should remain uncertain.
items.y: Revise scene_extractions/08_exploring_the_ruined_temple.md:15 and :416 to say that despite apparently failed active checks, the GM reveals the second door and the transcript does not preserve why it was found.
items.n: Keep stating that an Investigation roll turns up the door, implying a successful check not preserved by the transcript.
items.ev: The VTT records repeated ‘Nope’ results at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:7637-7641, followed by garbled discovery narration at :7649.

items.t: [Minor] ‘Follow tales only’ should be marked as unresolved ASR.
items.y: At scene_extractions/01_character_introductions_and_backstories.md:430, relabel the audio speaker as David Mendenhall and render the quote as unclear while preserving ‘Follow tales only’ in an editorial ASR note.
items.n: Keep the meaningless phrase as reliable Vukradin dialogue with no uncertainty marker.
items.ev: The cleaned VTT preserves the same unexplained words under David’s player label at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:1861.

items.t: [Minor] Vukradin’s summary should not claim an exact quote spoken by UNKNOWN.
items.y: At scene_extractions/02_a_new_beginning_setting_out_from_neverwinter.md:11, paraphrase that Vukradin continues to insist the flyer promised easy money; keep the exact ‘something about money’ quote under UNKNOWN in the verbatim section.
items.n: Keep the exact UNKNOWN line attached to Vukradin in the summary.
items.ev: The VTT marks ‘It definitely said something about money’ as UNKNOWN at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:2417, while Vukradin makes adjacent easy-money claims.

items.t: [Minor] The arrival time and travel duration should remain tentative.
items.y: Qualify scene_extractions/03_arrival_in_phandalin.md:135 as the GM tentatively placing the arrival early in the morning after several days’ travel.
items.n: Keep the time and duration as settled historical facts.
items.ev: The GM says ‘I’m assuming’ and ‘kind of like’ at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:3809 and :3813.

items.t: [Minor] The travel summary should not claim that every PC’s 30-foot speed was confirmed.
items.y: Revise scene_extractions/06_the_journey_to_the_excavation.md:228 to say the GM ruled the fifteen-mile trip a day’s hike and Soma separately confirmed her own speed as 30 feet.
items.n: Keep the unsupported claim that every party member has the same confirmed speed.
items.ev: The day’s-hike ruling appears at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:5109; only Soma confirms 30 feet at :5125.

items.t: [Minor] ‘Can you crap and scavenge food’ should be marked as unresolved ASR.
items.y: At scene_extractions/06_the_journey_to_the_excavation.md:62, label the speaker Gary Young and replace the uncertain verb with ‘[unclear],’ preserving ‘crap’ only in an editorial ASR note.
items.n: Keep the current Valphine attribution and present ‘crap’ as reliable dialogue.
items.ev: The VTT assigns the cue to Gary and preserves the questionable word at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:5177; the surrounding discussion is entirely about foraging.

items.t: [Minor] ‘Pet speed penalty’ should be marked as unresolved ASR.
items.y: At scene_extractions/06_the_journey_to_the_excavation.md:54, render the phrase as ‘there isn’t a [unclear] speed penalty’ and preserve raw ‘pet’ in an editorial note.
items.n: Keep ‘pet speed penalty’ as reliable GM dialogue even though the exchange concerns Soma’s own walking speed.
items.ev: The raw cleaned cue is at session_2025_05_14_chapter_2_transcript.speakers.cleaned.vtt:5153; Soma has just confirmed her own Tortle speed.

items.t: [Minor] ‘At least we have a good look’ should be marked as unresolved ASR.
items.y: At scene_extractions/06_the_journey_to_the_excavation.md:89, use Gary Young’s player label, mark the utterance unclear, and retain the raw ASR only in the editorial note.
